description:
Outcome: Viewers see waiting and helped visitors when opening or reloading the board, from BRIEF.md.
Scope: Read API, accessible groups/headings, agreed ordering/privacy, initial fetch and manual retry. Excludes: periodic refresh, background synchronization and SMS; automatic refresh is a separate ticket at the owner's request.
Acceptance: Opening/reloading displays current server state in the correct groups with only permitted fields.
Behaviour: Clear loading, empty and error states, with manual retry after a failed initial load.
Verification: API and UI tests using fixed queue fixtures, including privacy and grouping assertions. Prerequisites: T-004. Assumptions: no automatic freshness promise until T-010.
title: Build the board page
